clause: Raw develop model steerability + headless/quiet + manual + validation obligation [STU-RAW-018]

scope.summary: Enforce the develop cross-cutting obligation: every StudioRawDevelop control group, mask source, Enhance operation, profile/preset action, and workflow option is a typed model-steerable command with a stable identifier, observable through Argus (14.16); all raw develop ops run headless + quiet under 14.20 (no foreground window, no focus steal, bounded + observable); each carries a dual-audience UserManual entry (14.22) covering purpose, inputs/outputs, failure/recovery; and any model-authored develop edit passes sandbox -> StudioValidationDescriptor -> PromotionGate ([STU-ARC-005]) before it changes authority rows — model confidence never bypasses the gate.
acceptance_criteria: all develop ops model-steerable + Argus-observable + headless/quiet + manual-covered + promotion-gated
proof_targets: manual coverage + fail-closed promotion + quiet-headless audit
expected_tests: HBR-MAN-003: every studio.raw.* command_id has a manual entry
negative: model-authored develop edit blocked from direct authority write (fails closed via PromotionGate)
argus+quiet: raw ops observable headless with no focus steal

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

risk_if_missed: Ungated/unobservable/undocumented develop commands; model edits bypass validation.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
